t: This is All Hallows-on-the-Wall, a Church of England church in the City of London. The name tells you where you are: it stands inside and beside London Wall, the old city wall. It was designed by George Dance the Younger, the youngest son of the architect George Dance the Elder, from a family of architects, artists and dramatists. Sir John Summerson called him among the few really outstanding architects of his century, though few of his buildings survive. That makes this one worth a good look.
